summary.text: Meriam Sabih is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 131 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Milou Mackenzie.

A freelance journalist with a master's degree in political science from Lehigh University, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities include lowering costs, public education and protecting elections.

paragraphs.text: Meriam Sabih earned a bachelor's degree from Rutgers University and a graduate degree from Lehigh University, and her career experience includes journalism.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked as a freelance journalist for more than a decade, has three sons in public schools, and is the daughter of public servants: her mother worked in a Veterans hospital and her father is a union member.
Sabih also ran for the seat in 2024, when she lost the District 131 general election to incumbent Milou Mackenzie, 42.7 percent to 57.2 percent.
She advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary for the seat with 99.8 percent of the vote.

Her 2026 survey responses list lowering the cost of everyday essentials, prioritizing public education and defending democracy as her key messages, along with economic growth that protects Pennsylvania's natural beauty.
